subject: Subvendor addition: EdgeLogix (subprocessor) — data processing & DPA addendum request
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subvendor addition: EdgeLogix (subprocessor) — data processing & DPA addendum request

Hi Bethany,

Thanks for the heads up on EdgeLogix being added as a downstream processor for the log-aggregation portion of the Acme Retail account. Before we can accept the delegation, Legal needs a short DPA addendum and a couple of security artifacts. Can you confirm the following so we can keep Acme's go-live on track?

- Exact scope: confirm which DataSafe services call EdgeLogix and whether logs contain any PII.
- Dataflow: small diagram or description of what is sent to EdgeLogix and retention period.
- Security evidence: current SOC 2 Type II report or a link to a security portal; encryption at-rest/in-transit details.
- Subprocessor list: confirm any further nested subprocessors used by EdgeLogix.

If you can share the artifacts as attachments or a secure link I will loop Legal (cc'd) to prepare a short DPA addendum. We typically require a 30-day notification window for new subprocessors, but if Acme is on a tight schedule we can look at an accelerated approval workflow.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate on our side.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Subvendor addition: EdgeLogix (subprocessor) — data processing & DPA addendum request

Diego — thanks for the quick note.

EdgeLogix will only receive aggregated application logs and a subset of diagnostic traces used for indexing and retention. No customer credentials or payment data are included. Retention is 90 days by default.

I can attach our SOC 2 Type II and EdgeLogix's security overview — will that work? If you have a Redwood DPA addendum template you prefer, please forward and we can sign via DocuSign. Acme is hoping to close the change this week; they have an internal deadline on Friday.

Attachment plan: I will upload DataSafe_SOC2_Type2.pdf and EdgeLogix_Security_Overview.pdf to a secure link and send here.

—Bethany
Bethany Lee

bethany.lee@datasafeinc.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>; Bethany Lee <bethany.lee@datasafeinc.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Subvendor addition: EdgeLogix — please advise (redlines / addendum)

Marissa — forwarding DataSafe's alert. Acme needs EdgeLogix added and DataSafe is offering SOC2 and a security overview. They asked if we have a DPA addendum template to speed signing. Can Legal prepare a short addendum with the following minimal guards and redline guidance:

- Standard subprocessor warranty and flow-down to EdgeLogix
- Data retention cap of 90 days for logs tied to this work
- Requirement for SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) on an annual basis and notification within 10 business days of any security incident
- Encryption at-rest and in-transit (TLS 1.2+ / AES-256 at rest)
- Carveouts: negotiated limited right to audit vs. hosted evidence portal access
- A one-time exception path if EdgeLogix uses a back-end subvendor that is common infra (we prefer lists and prior notice)

Also advise if we should push for a 30-day notice vs. a 10-business-day expedited approval for this account. Bethany — attaching your note to Legal for redline.

Diego
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>; Bethany Lee <bethany.lee@datasafeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Subvendor addition: EdgeLogix — please advise (redlines / addendum)

Diego / Bethany — thanks for the context. I drafted a short DPA addendum that can be executed in parallel with our order-form amendment; attaching as Redwood_DPA_Addendum_v1.docx. High-level notes and ask list below.

1) Scope & flow-down language: explicit mapping to the log-aggregation service (list the Acme account ID) and mandatory flow-down of data protection obligations to EdgeLogix.
2) Security evidence: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II (DataSafe) and the EdgeLogix security overview. If EdgeLogix cannot share SOC 2, they must grant portal access and an independent attestation within 90 days.
3) Incident notification: 10 business days for breach notice is acceptable, but we require immediate notification for active exfiltration; add preservation of logs clause.
4) Encryption: require TLS 1.2+ and AES-256 at rest (or equivalent). Please confirm cipher suite in your portal doc.
5) Subprocessor list & nested subprocessors: request full list and a commitment to provide 30 days' notice for additions. We can accept a 10-business-day compressed approval for this specific Acme go-live if DataSafe provides complete artifacts now.
6) Audit rights: prefer hosted evidence + SOC / penetration test summaries in lieu of on-site audit. If Acme requires on-site, we will negotiate granular scope.
7) Limited liability / indemnity: standard mutual indemnities, no special carveouts requested at this stage.

Bethany — can you confirm EdgeLogix's nested subprocessors and either attach EdgeLogix SOC2 or provide a portal link we can validate? If you can get the artifacts by EOD we can cut an addendum and fire DocuSign.

- Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Additional nested subprocessors are minimal — Simon from EdgeLogix (cc'd) confirms they use CloudLogix for storage and SearchStack for indexing; both are listed in the security overview.

We also spun up a temporary portal access for Redwood: https://security.datasafeinc.com/redwood/rdw-4721 (portal requires one-time MFA; I can add Marissa and Hannah).

Simon — can you confirm retention controls and whether logs are written with any user identifiers?

I will also prepare a DocuSign envelope if Marissa can confirm the addendum is ready. Acme wants the change live by Friday; they have procurement approval pending signature.

—Bethany
